subject: AWS Marketplace: Metering & Fulfillment onboarding for BrightLayer (co-sell)
messages:
From: Alice Mendoza <alice@brightlayer.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightlayer.io
Date: 2025-11-18T08:42:00-08:00
Subject: AWS Marketplace: BrightLayer metering + fulfillment onboarding

Hi Neha,

Thanks again for the demo last week — BrightLayer is excited to move our SaaS listing into AWS Marketplace and take advantage of the co-sell route.  A few items we need to get in motion on the marketplace side so procurement and engineering can align: 

- Metered usage: we will sell via a per-seat + metered token add-on; need Redwood's guidance on product_code and the entitlement mapping you recommend.
- Fulfillment: who will own the fulfillment webhooks (Redwood or BrightLayer)? We need the webhook spec early so our engineering team can wire consumption events.
- Contracting & billing: procurement will need a SaaS contract + invoice flow (PO to Redwood) and a DocuSign envelope if possible.

Attaching the internal project brief and our procurement contact for reference. Can we do a short kickoff this week and get a Mutual Action Plan?

Thanks,
Alice
Alice Mendoza
Head of Partnerships | BrightLayer
alice@brightlayer.io
attachments: BrightLayer_ProjectBrief.pdf (pdf)
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Mendoza <alice@brightlayer.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-18T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace: BrightLayer metering + fulfillment onboarding

Hi Alice — great to meet you over the demo. Welcome aboard.

Short answer on the bullets:
- Entitlement mapping: we typically map your SKU -> AWS product_code and expose an entitlement per-customer. I attached our Metering Checklist with the exact fields we need (product_code, sku_id, license_model).
- Fulfillment webhooks: Redwood can host the fulfillment endpoint for the metering bridge (recommended for lower ops burden). If BrightLayer prefers to host, we can provide the webhook spec and a test harness.
- Contracting: we can send a DocuSign for the SaaS order form + master services addendum; procurement flow below.

I attached a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that outlines owners, deliverables, and target go-live dates. Proposed kickoff (30 min): Thursday 11/20 10:00 AM PT. Does that work for procurement + engineering?

Next steps I will take this morning:
1) Send MAP and Metering Checklist (attached).
2) Pull our AWS seller ID and outline the Product/Entitlement mapping template.
3) Loop in Karthik on contracting and Marissa on fulfillment runbook.

Thanks — cc'ing Karthik and Marissa to confirm availability.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0126
attachments: Redwood_Marketplace_MutualActionPlan.docx (docx); Metering_Checklist.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Mendoza <alice@brightlayer.io>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-11-19T09:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace: BrightLayer metering + fulfillment onboarding

Hi Alice — thanks for the materials. Looping in Ben (billing ops) to confirm invoicing and PO flow. A few procurement asks from our side so we can prepare the DocuSign: 

- Contract term (12/24/36 months)? Please confirm preferred term and renewal model.
- Billing contact and address for invoice/PO.
- Any specific compliance addenda (SOC2 level or data residency requirements).

I've created a DocuSign envelope for the SaaS order form and will send once you confirm term and billing contact. DocuSign link: https://docusign.net/ds/BL-2025-0893

Ben — can you confirm Redwood's standard invoice cadence for marketplace purchases and whether we should route BrightLayer to our marketplace fulfillment or issue direct invoices (post-fulfillment)?

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.ai
From: Alice Mendoza <alice@brightlayer.io>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@brightlayer.io, aws-marketplace@amazon.com
Date: 2025-11-20T11:47:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace: BrightLayer metering + fulfillment onboarding

Karthik / Neha — thanks. Procurement will issue a PO this week (we expect PO # BL-PO-2105). I'm attaching the PO as soon as it's signed. A few technical clarifications for your engineers so we can map entitlements: 

- AWS will require a product_code (we need the value to include in our seller onboarding).
- For fulfillment if Redwood hosts the metering bridge, we need the expected event JSON and the test endpoint so our devs can emit events before go-live.
- Can you share your AWS seller ID and whether BrightLayer will be listed under Redwood's co-sell program or a linked seller relationship?

Attached: BL-PO-2105.pdf (initial PO PDF)

On the timeline: procurement hopes to complete contracting + PO signature by 11/24. We are targeting a soft go-live window of the week of 12/8. Does that align with your MAP?

Best,
Alice
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Mendoza <alice@brightlayer.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Bcc: 
Date: 2025-11-21T16:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace: BrightLayer metering + fulfillment onboarding

Alice — appreciate the quick turnaround. Confirming next steps and details from Redwood's side: 

1) AWS seller ID: 326-449-882 (please confirm if you need the exact account alias for the listing).
2) Product_code template: redwood.bl.<brightlayer_product_code> — we will populate the final value in the MAP once BrightLayer confirms SKU IDs.
3) Fulfillment approach: Redwood will host the metering bridge. Below is the minimal test payload for ingestion (also attached as a developer guide):

--- sample event ---
{
  "event_type": "usage_report",
  "timestamp": "2025-12-01T15:00:00Z",
  "customer_reference": "br-12345",
  "product_code": "redwood.bl.token_addon",
  "usage_units": 12456
}
--- end ---

Test endpoint (staging): https://staging-metering.redwood.ai/webhook/brightlayer/test (basic auth token will be provided to your devs)

4) Contracting: Karthik will send the DocuSign envelope once BrightLayer confirms term and billing contact. We can accept PO # BL-PO-2105 and apply it to the first invoice.

5) Timeline: MAP updated to reflect target soft go-live week of 2025-12-08 — our SRE and CS teams are available for the cutover window 12/08-12/12.

Attachments: AWS_Webhook_Guide.md (md), Redwood_Marketplace_MutualActionPlan.docx (docx)

If that all looks good, I'll schedule the kickoff for 11/24 at 10:00 AM PT (shorter than previously proposed) — please confirm by EOD.

Best regards,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0126
